_doc: Quiet growth on every level-up (scripts/match/level_growth.gd), straight lines as in the source (docs/ABILITIES.md 'Level growth'). Each level a hunter reaches adds hp (a share of the class's base health: the source's ~6% of base per level, docs/SUPERVIVE_DATA.md section 6) and ap (ability power: a multiplier on ability damage, and on healing and shields from abilities; the source's +5 Power a level comes to ~3.9% of an ability's level-1 number, from Myth's level-1 and level-15 tooltips in briefs/supervive-data/supervive_kits.md). Nothing pops up for it: the level badge flashes and its tooltip shows the totals. xp: what each source gives toward the next run level (LevelGrowth.xp; the level table XP_TO and the ranks stay in scripts/match/hunter.gd): knock for knocking a rival Hunter down (monster and lair boss kills pay through scripts/match/kill_xp.gd). Paced in docs/LEVEL_PACE.md.
